description.describe_ch:
Calculus is a course provides basic training in mathematics. It involves the differentiation and the integration. These are used to solve problems via geometry and algebra. Calculus has a lot of
applications in many fields, such as science, business, economics and management. The materials in Calculus for Business and Aviation include the functions and graphs, limits of functions, the derivatives, the integrals, the partial differentiation

targets.describe_ch: Understand the definition of the functions and graphs
targets.describe_en: Understand the definition of the functions and graphs

targets.describe_ch: Understand the limits of functions and be able to compute the limits by applying basic formulas.
targets.describe_en: Understand the limits of functions and be able to compute the limits by applying basic formulas.

targets.describe_ch: Understand the definition of the derivatives and be able to compute the derivatives via basic properties
targets.describe_en: Understand the definition of the derivatives and be able to compute the derivatives via basic properties

targets.describe_ch: Be able to apply the derivatives to analyze the monotonicity and concavity of functions
targets.describe_en: Be able to apply the derivatives to analyze the monotonicity and concavity of functions

targets.describe_ch: Be able to apply the derivatives to solve the maximum and minimum problems
targets.describe_en: Be able to apply the derivatives to solve the maximum and minimum problems

targets.describe_ch: Realize the concept of the integrals and be able to apply fundamental theorem of calculus to compute the integrals
targets.describe_en: Realize the concept of the integrals and be able to apply fundamental theorem of calculus to compute the integrals

targets.describe_ch: Be able to use a definite integral to obtain the area of the region between curves
targets.describe_en: Be able to use a definite integral to obtain the area of the region between curves

targets.describe_ch: Be able to find the derivatives of logarithmic, exponential and trigonometric functions
targets.describe_en: Be able to find the derivatives of logarithmic, exponential and trigonometric functions

targets.describe_ch: Understand the partial derivatives and be able to compute the partial derivatives via basic Properties
targets.describe_en: Understand the partial derivatives and be able to compute the partial derivatives via basic Properties

weeklyScds.tpd_reading: The Natural Exponential and Natural Logarithm Functions ; The Limit of a Function
weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en: Introduction of functions, Rate of change and  limits

weeklyScds.tpd_reading:
Calculating Limits Using the Limit Laws;
Limit involving infinity, Vertical Asymptote,
Limits at Infinity; Horizontal Asymptotes

The Derivatives as a Function
Differentiation Rules (Power Rule)
Derivatives of Polynomials and Exponential Functions;
weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en: Differentiation Rules (Power Rule, Product Rule, Quotient Rule, Chain Rule)

weeklyScds.tpd_reading:
Differentiation Rules (Product Rule, Quotient Rule, Chain Rule)
Derivatives of Trigonometric functions;

weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en: Implicit Differentiation, Derivatives of Inverse functions and Logarithms

weeklyScds.tpd_reading:
Implicit Differentiation,
Derivatives of Inverse functions and Logarithms;
Derivatives of  Logarithms
weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en: Derivatives of Inverse Functions and Logarithms

weeklyScds.tpd_reading:
Linearization and differentials
Extreme Values of Functions;
Monotonicity and concavity;
weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en: Extreme Values of Functions and Linearization,

weeklyScds.tpd_reading: The First and Second Tests for Extrema,

weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en: The First and Second Tests for Extrema,
Indeterminate Forms and L'Hopital's Rule; Antiderivatives

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
A. Two Midterm Exams (20% each),
B. Final Exam (20%),
C. Attendance and inclass performance (15%）
D. Homework assignments (10%）
E. TA recitation  (15%)
F. Teacher or TA consulation at least three times (with teacher or TA's signature as proof)
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol: Be on time for the lecture, if 20 minutes late for the lecture will be marked as absence for one hour.  To concentrate in class and follow the lecture to finish the exercises in class and due on time in the assigned deadline.  Do the homework regularly after class and be honest in the tests. Anyone who violates the test regulations will be processed according to the FCU test regulations.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:

2) To concentrate in class and follow the lecture to finish the exercises in class and due on time in the assigned deadline.

4) Do your own homework ask questions in class or time break or in the consultation hours.
5) You have to get Four stamps from TA or Teacher in this semester. (Every time you ask questions from TA or teacher, you will get a stamp)
